svg.title: A flood report is rejected for lacking local rain and an incident number.
svg.desc: Two red validation blocks descend over the timestamped upstream warning: one represents the clear rain threshold, the other an empty incident-number field. Babul leaves with his bell while Riju protests.
svg.text: Page 41, panel 3 · Frontal close shot as two procedural gates close over the report
